thread:
maria-p: Customer ACME (prod) reported sudden p99 token latency from ~120ms -> 1.2s starting ~09:12 UTC, and a couple of 502s. They say region shows us-east but traces hop to eu-west. attaching trace snippet and repro steps. :mag_right:

maria-p: trace ids: trace-0a1b2c, trace-0a1b2d
maria-p: repro curl (internal):
```
curl -H 'X-Client-Region: us-east-1' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -v
```

maria-p: full trace excerpt (sanitized):
```
start -> edge-us-east-1 -> lb-us-east-1 -> proxy-eu-west-1 -> model-pool-eu-west-1 -> lb-us-east-1 -> finish
```

sam_irwin: pinging eng-networking, this looks like a routing leak. can you paste the raw trace headers? :eyes:

alex_chiu: @maria-p can you share the request ID header (x-request-id) from the customer's failing requests?

maria-p: added x-request-id: acme-req-7743 and acme-req-7744, also uploaded pcap to the case. link: https://internal.redwood/cases/ACME-921 :link:

routebot: Incident created INC-2026-0921, severity: high, assigned: oncall-network

oncall-rotations-bot: oncall-network: @sam_irwin (06:00-14:00 UTC) has been paged.

sam_irwin: looking now. initial read: proxy-eu-west-1 is seeing upstream connections with client region header us-east but source ASN resolves to eu transit. suspicious.

devon_ops: I queried our routecache for acme tenant, saw a recent policy push at 09:10 UTC that added a prefix match for 203.0.113.0/24 to prefer eu-west pool for affinity optimization.

alex_chiu: that policy change was intended for a subset of tenants (beta-affinity). was ACME included by mistake?

devon_ops: yes, the rolloutexpr matched a broad tenant regex. patching now, rolling back the rule.

sam_irwin: rollback in progress. I put an immediate exclude for tenant-id: acme-prod and flushed routecache on edge-us-east-1.

maria-p: customer on call now, they see first requests starting getting normal latency again. :thumbsup:

sam_irwin: monitoring p99 and throughput. created a short-term mitigation to pin acme to us-east route by tenant header.

alex_chiu: we should add stricter tests to the rollout pipeline to avoid global regex matches. filed task: ENG-ops-1427.

devon_ops: confirmed rollback applied across all edge clusters at 09:24 UTC.

maria-p: will keep the customer updated and request postmortem. thanks team. :pray:

sam_irwin: leaving the thread open to confirm no residual 502s. will close when p99 stable for 30m.

maria-p: 30m passed, p99 back to baseline. closing. :white_check_mark:
